text.p: Morgans Stockbroking Ltd was recommending Jupiters Ltd as a buy investment, following expectations the casino and hotel operator would show further profit growth from its operations.
"Buy. Further profit growth is expected from the Brisbane casino and the introduction of Keno," Morgan analyst Sophie Mitchell said in a report.
While most of Jupiters' profit growth came from its Gold Coast casino-hotel, the group's Brisbane casino and hotel continued to improve its performance, Mitchell said.
Patronage at the Brisbane casino was averaging 10,000 daily, while hotel occupancy also was increasing, Mitchell said.
A A$16 million upgrade of the Brisbane casino facilities was being undertaken and would be completed during 1997, she said.
Morgan was forecasting net profits for Jupiters to increase to A$42.6 million in the current year ended June 30, 1997 from a reported $33.8 million in the 1995/96 year.

The Keno agreement which has been signed with the Queensland state government enabled the development and operation of a state-wide Keno game through clubs, hotels and betting agencies, Mitchell said.
"The development of Keno will provide Jupiters with a new source of earnings growth," she said.
Jupiters shares were one cent firmer at A$2.75 at 12.40 p.m. (0140 GMT).
